This repository is a Vite + React JavaScript recreation of the Bhanu Vamshi portfolio.

- Use React components and state for interactive UI; avoid reintroducing imperative DOM rendering.
- Keep portfolio copy and professional data in `src/content.json`.
- Keep supplied image files in `public/asset/` and reference them by root-relative URL.
- Preserve the source portfolio's responsive visual language in `src/App.css`.
- Validate changes with `npm run lint` and `npm run build`.
